population_checks: Fold image IDs, per-image valid/error counts, model selection split and model digests match frozen archives.

policy.score: ascending predicted error; 100000 equally spaced arcsine-square-root score bins
policy.budget: Original float64 floor((p/100)*N+0.5), clamped to [1,N]. Budget identical across all six methods within each group.
policy.within_boundary_bin: Uniform selection without replacement, independent of labels. Report expectation, not observed tie order.
policy.aggregation: Arithmetic mean of within-group accepted error rates. Overall weights each of 17 groups equally.
policy.paired_units: RF minus reference in percentage points. Win below -tolerance, loss above +tolerance.

fine_grid: Direct histogram queries from 10.0 to 90.0% every 0.1 percentage point. Range endpoints are measured grid values; no between-point sign claim.
sensitivity_Night_QA: Archived raw scores, weighted QA sample with independent tie keys. Secondary evidence only.
plot_grid: One pixel per group at first target; additional small positive budgets, then every 0.1 percentage point to 100%. No risk at zero.
